title: Intent Evidence
description: Evidence categories used to reason about intent.

entries.title: Direct Evidence
entries.description: The sentence states the intent plainly.

entries.title: Contextual Evidence
entries.description: The surrounding scene clarifies the meaning.

entries.title: Cross-Sentence Evidence
entries.description: Later lines confirm or change the meaning.

entries.title: Scene Evidence
entries.description: The whole scene changes how the line should be read.

entries.title: Contradicting Evidence
entries.description: Later dialogue or action weakens the initial guess.

entries.title: Quotation Evidence
entries.description: The phrase is quoted rather than asserted.

entries.title: Performance Evidence
entries.description: The line is part of acting, role play, or narration.

entries.title: Neutrality Evidence
entries.description: The text stays descriptive and uncommitted.
